label: Phuket & Andaman coast
hint: Southern with a softer Phuket accent
notes: Southern vocabulary as in the South pack. Phuket speech is described as slower and softer, with many final polite particles dropped, and Hokkien-derived words from the tin-mining era (fading among younger people). Source: The Thaiger, Wikipedia.
accentHint: Speak Thai with a Phuket accent (Southern Thai, but slower, softer and more flowing than the Hat Yai accent), dropping some final sounds.

male.th: หรอยจังหู้ครับ

female.th: หรอยจังหู้ค่ะ
